prompt: Just Singapore news today please — local news and SG market news. Nothing else.
expected_output: Poll scoped to the singapore category only: local sources (CNA, Straits Times, Business Times, Google News SG), no other category sections

assertions.name: singapore_section_present
assertions.description: Output must contain the singapore category section heading (anchored line match — a title starting with 'US' must not count as a section)

assertions.name: scope_excludes_other_regions
assertions.description: Output must have exactly ONE section heading — singapore — and no us/china/markets/important/research sections

assertions.name: local_sg_sources
assertions.description: Representative stories must link to local SG outlets (CNA, Straits Times, Business Times)

assertions.name: story_urls_present
assertions.description: Output must carry at least 3 source URLs

assertions.name: no_crash_output
assertions.description: Output must not contain a Python traceback
